_comment: ShipIt-managed Claude Code settings. The hooks protect the session branch and enforce PR creation when enabled.
_permissions_comment: Explicit file-tool permissions protect settings and credential files while keeping project memory writable. Only Edit(path) rules are path-matched, and they cover Write and NotebookEdit too; //x is absolute, ~/x is under HOME, and a single leading / is relative to this file's directory (docs/097-explicit-session-agent-permissions).
_persist_comment: The //persist rule names the real path: a write through a workspace symlink waits for the user's approval unless a path rule matches its target (docs/193-sensitive-file-permission).
_connectors_comment: Disable account connectors because session containers cannot complete their OAuth flows.
